constraints: Prefer small high-value standards over giant style doctrine.
Prefer a short automation shortlist over an idea dump.
Review old infra as patterns, not activation commitments.
mission: Promote useful imported engineering-process, automation, security, and deployment-pattern memory into current operating standards.
review_focus: Which process rules still materially improve current work?
Which automations have real operator value instead of novelty value?
Which security and infra patterns are still modern and useful?
